column1: # What socket(2) does on real Linux, behind the libSystem.Native shim's own
# argument screens. Measured 2026-08-19 on Linux 6.18.5 aarch64 (Apple
# `container`, docker.io/library/gcc:13) at **euid 1000**, by a C program that
# mirrors the shim's three TryConvert*PalToPlatform functions and then calls
# euid 1000 because that is EmulatedKernel.defaultUserId. 70 of these rows
# answer differently at euid 0 -- every SOCK_RAW row and every AF_PACKET row,
# gated by CAP_NET_RAW -- and those become OK there. PawPrint refuses them under
# either identity, so this file is the oracle for the *default* configuration
# and a host that sets UserId = 0 gets a loud refusal rather than a wrong answer.
# aarch64 rather than x86-64, which SimulatedUnixPlatform.linuxX64 names: none of
# these answers is architecture-dependent, socket(2)'s protocol tables being
# Columns: address family, socket type, protocol (all PAL names), then either
#   SCREEN <which>   the shim refused before any syscall
